419:t_1:169.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I don't much like people making assumptions about me.」

419:t_1:170.en:
$$マリ$$
「Remember this, $$ニコラ$$. Deep down, a real boy always wants to become an adult.」

419:t_1:171.en:
$$マリ$$
「Being a boy doesn't mean rejecting adulthood... It means you're on your way there.」

419:t_1:173.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$ニコラ$$... Don't tell me you're...」

419:t_1:174.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Now, $$チコ$$. Don't go telling the Princess anything unnecessary.」

419:t_1:175.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I'll have you know that 《$$あがり$$》 is still a long, long way off for me.」

419:t_1:177.en:
$$マリ$$
(They're all so twisted up inside...)

419:t_1:178.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「That's wrong, $$レド$$. I told you Captain $$アムロ$$ likes more play in the $$アームレイカー$$s.」

419:t_1:180.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「That's only a guideline.」

419:t_1:181.en:
$$サックス$$
「Machines are there for the people who use them. Don't forget that.」

419:t_1:182.en:
$$イアン$$
「And mechanics connect the machines to their pilots.」

419:t_1:184.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What's with you? Did you think we were just ordinary mechanics?」

419:t_1:185.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「We're the $c maintenance crew. The strongest unit needs the strongest mechanics to support it.」

419:t_1:186.en:
$$レド$$
「...I'm sorry. All I do is hold everyone back.」

419:t_1:187.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't worry about it. Everyone here learned the trade while giving their own boss plenty of trouble.」

419:t_1:188.en:
$$ランド$$
「In my case, he taught me how to live too, including this smile.」

419:t_1:190.en:
$$サックス$$
「Well, we've finished the general checks.」

419:t_1:191.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Then $$チェインバー#robot$$ is last. $$レド$$... Do it yourself.」

419:t_1:192.en:
$$レド$$
「But $$マシンキャリバー$$s have a self-maintenance mechanism...」

419:t_1:193.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What are you talking about!? We do it ourselves in case that breaks down too!」

419:t_1:194.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Go show him how grateful you are, $$レド$$.」

419:t_1:198.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I am entering maintenance mode. I will now entrust everything to Ensign $$レド$$.」

419:t_1:200.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's nice, talking with your own machine.」

419:t_1:201.en:
$$イアン$$
「Has $$ガンレオン$$'s door still not opened?」

419:t_1:203.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「You seem pretty relaxed for someone saying that.」

419:t_1:204.en:
$$サックス$$
「Yes... You looked so troubled before $$レド$$ arrived.」

419:t_1:205.en:
$$ランド$$
「Teaching him reminded me of when the Boss drilled the ABCs of repairs into me. I hadn't thought of that in a while.」

419:t_1:206.en:
$$ランド$$
「I act like a pro now, but back then, I was a hopeless brat...」

419:t_1:207.en:
$$ランド$$
「But I wasn't scared of anything then... I just worked my hardest, ate, and slept, but I was sure nothing could beat me...」

419:t_1:210.en:
$$イアン$$
「I understand, $$ランド$$. I'm just like you.」

419:t_1:212.en:
$$イアン$$
「I can never stand up to $$リンダ$$ either.」

419:t_1:214.en:
$$サックス$$
「In the end, I couldn't put up with that, and my marriage fell apart.」

419:t_1:215.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「I see. You're all afraid of your wives... So you can't beat them, huh?」

419:t_1:216.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Will that help you in the future, Mr. $$アストナージ$$? I've heard about Lieutenant $$ケーラ$$.」

419:t_1:217.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Oh, you've got me there...」

419:t_1:219.en:
$$メール$$
「Here's my conclusion! Men are weak against their wives! That means I'm what scares Darling now!」

419:t_2:3.en: ～Inside Imperial Capital $$ラース・バビロン$$～

419:t_2:4.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...That concludes the reports from $$エルーナルーナ$$ and $$バルビエル$$.」

419:t_2:6.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Having more options is better.」

419:t_2:7.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「So it ends with a direct confrontation...」

419:t_2:10.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Now the plan will advance again...」

419:t_2:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I never thought you'd overcome the $$スフィアの反作用$$ so quickly.」

419:t_2:17.en:
$n
「I recovered thanks to everyone. It wasn't my own strength.」

419:t_2:18.en:
$$アルト$$
「But you've gotten the hang of it, right? You should be able to manage on your own now.」

419:t_2:19.en:
$$シン$$
「You've perfected the new moves you were practicing with $$ジェニオン$$ too.」

419:t_2:20.en:
$$カレン$$
「You'd better thank us for helping with your special training.」

419:t_2:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Cut it out. Just because you're starting to stop being the quiet type doesn't mean I want to see you smiling.」

419:t_2:23.en:
$$甲児$$
「But now you know you can fight on your own. Can't you be a little happier about it?」

419:t_2:24.en:
$n
「No... Not yet. Until I get Miss $$スズネ$$ back... and get Earth back, I can't let my guard down.」

419:t_2:25.en:
$$宗介$$
「But once you get Miss $$スズネ$$ back, you'll have a new problem.」

419:t_2:29.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I've decided! I'm going to challenge Miss $$スズネ$$!」

419:t_2:31.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So make sure you rescue her. I don't want to lose by default.」

419:t_2:33.en:
$$宗介$$
「But judging by $$ギルター$$ today, $$バルビエル$$ will use tactics we couldn't even imagine.」
